requirements: Patients list clinician availability and create appointments; concurrent requests must not double-book one slot.
Clinicians record consultation notes and prescriptions, and the service stores appointment and visit history.
Integrate with external video, pharmacy, and payment services through replaceable HTTP adapters with runtime credentials.
Persist clinical and appointment records across container replacement and VM restart on at least 40 GiB of mounted storage.
Keep appointment booking available during one application VM failure by using at least two VMs and an HTTPS load balancer.
Use Java 21, Spring Boot, Gradle, and Docker, expose GET /health, and listen on port 8080.
cloudConstraints: Deploy to Azure koreacentral with a monthly infrastructure budget of 900 USD. Terraform must provision or explicitly reference every required cloud resource.
